title: Raise the per-file read limit from 25k tokens to 100k
description: Read refuses files over 25,000 tokens and tells you to use offset/limit instead. This raises the default ceiling. An explicit maxTokens in settings still wins, since the constant is only the fallback.

sites.description: maxTokens inside the defaultFileReadingLimits object: `r() ?? <const>`. Anchored on that property name rather than on proximity to a <system-reminder> string — the standalone script matched `=25000,` within 100 characters of one, and 25000 appears in at least six chunks on 2.1.280 as the MCP output cap, a checkpoint size and an artifact threshold. Any of those could sit near that text once the bundle is split.
The declarator that property pointed at. Same-file, since a single-word minified name is only unique within its own module.
